title: 第1192章 阻止破镜第1191章 众神恐慌
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
要知道，力之大道。
是属于传说中的那个世界，洪荒盘古的力之大道。
那个曾经一斧劈开混沌，斩杀三千魔神的恐怖存在，他的传承竟然在陆盘身上苏醒了。
而且苏醒得如此彻底。
如此狂暴。
轮回葬主活了太久的岁月，曾经，他跨越时间长河，窥探过盘古开天的场景。
那个时候他还只是一缕刚诞生灵智的葬土阴魂。
他躲在混沌最边缘的角落里瑟瑟发抖，眼睁睁看着盘古一斧接一斧地劈开混沌。
那种力量，那种霸道，那种无与伦比的气场，深深烙印在他的灵魂本源之中。
那一幕，是他永远挥之不去的噩梦。
现在。
那个噩梦又回来了。
“主宰，我们怎么办？”
跪在最前方的第一葬将小心翼翼地问道。
轮回葬主没有回答。
他站起了身。
骨架摩擦的声音在空荡荡的葬殿中回响，令人牙酸。
他的鬼火双眸望向远方，那火焰越烧越旺，几乎要从眼眶中喷涌而出。
“诸天万界的规矩，是诸天万界一起定的。”
“道主境的存在已经足够多了。”

“不需要再多一个。”
轮回葬主的声音低沉得可怕。
他一步踏出，脚下浮现出六道轮回虚影。
那六道虚影疯狂旋转，每旋转一圈，虚空就崩碎一层。
十二葬将跪在地上，额头紧紧贴着地面。
他们知道，主宰这次是真的动了杀心。
那种从灵魂本源中涌出的杀意，瞒不过追随了他无尽纪元的十二葬将。
轮回葬主的身影消失在虚空裂缝中。
十二葬将这才敢抬起头。
他们互相看了一眼，都从彼此眼中看到了深深的忧虑。
诸天万界的天，要变了。
荒古兽界。
一声惊天动地的咆哮响彻整个兽界。
那是荒兽之主的怒吼。
整个荒古兽界都在这声怒吼中颤抖。
无数体长万丈的太古荒兽齐齐匍匐在地，浑身战栗。
荒兽之主的本体，是一头体型超过百万丈的太古混沌兽。
此刻他正盘踞在兽界中央的混沌圣山之上。
他的九颗头颅同时仰天咆哮，每一颗头颅都喷吐出不同颜色的毁灭吐息。
赤色的焚天烈焰。
content_en:
You know, the avenue of strength.
It belongs to the legendary world, the great avenue of power of ancient times.
The terrifying existence that once split chaos with an ax and killed three thousand demon gods, his inheritance actually awakened in Lu Pan.
And he woke up so completely.
So violent.
Samsara Burial Master has lived for too long. Once, he crossed the river of time and spied on the scene when Pangu opened the sky.
At that time, he was just a burial ghost with a newly born spiritual intelligence.
He hid in the corner at the edge of Chaos and shivered, watching helplessly as Pangu chopped open Chaos with axe after axe.
That kind of power, that kind of domineering, that kind of unparalleled aura is deeply imprinted in the origin of his soul.
That scene was a nightmare that would never go away for him.
Now.
That nightmare is back.
"Lord, what should we do?"
The first burial general kneeling at the front asked cautiously.
The reincarnation burial master did not answer.
He stood up.
The sound of bones rubbing against each other echoed in the empty burial hall, which was heartbreaking.
His will-o'-the-wisp eyes looked into the distance, and the flames grew stronger and stronger, almost bursting out of his eyes.
"The rules of all heavens and all realms are set by all heavens and all realms together."
"There are already enough existences in the Taoist realm."
"No need for one more."
The voice of the Samsara Burial Master was terrifyingly deep.
He took one step forward, and six phantoms of reincarnation appeared under his feet.
The six phantoms rotated crazily, and each time they rotated, the void collapsed.
The twelve burial generals knelt on the ground with their foreheads pressed tightly against the ground.
They knew that the Lord was really murderous this time.
The killing intent that surged from the source of his soul could not be concealed from the Twelve Buried Generals who had followed him for endless eras.
The figure of the Samsara Burial Master disappeared into the cracks in the void.
Only then did the twelve burial generals dare to raise their heads.
They looked at each other and saw deep worry in each other's eyes.
The heavens of all heavens and realms are about to change.
The ancient beast world.
An earth-shattering roar resounded throughout the beast world.
That was the roar of the Lord of Wild Beasts.
The entire ancient beast world trembled in this roar.
Countless ancient wild beasts with a body length of ten thousand feet were all lying on the ground, trembling all over.
The main body of the Lord of Desolate Beasts is an ancient chaotic beast with a size exceeding one million feet.
At this moment, he is entrenched on the Holy Mountain of Chaos in the center of the beast world.
His nine heads looked up to the sky and roared at the same time, each head spitting out a different color of destructive breath.
The red sky-burning flames.
